pages.title: Residual Starlight
pages.text: The light left over when matter goes beyond stellar temperatures. It is a hot, glowing gas that carries the memory of every star that went into it. It moves like a slow, luminous fog. Its glow is the colour of a sky just after a star has set.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Pushing a Stellar Core beyond its limits in the Transcendent Plasma Forge, with magnetar and pentaquark shards, the matter gave off a glowing gas. Residual starlight, the afterglow of transcendence.
